description_en: Counts the join permissions that are rented by the current user account and match the specified filter conditions
description_zh: 统计当前用户账号所租用的且符合过滤条件的入网凭证数量
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan count-rented-join-permissions --fuzzy-owner-aliyun-id some-user --fuzzy-join-eui d896e0 --enabled true --bound-node-group true --type LOCAL --fuzzy-join-permission-name test --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CountRentedJoinPermissions

parameters.help_en: Fuzzy match of the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission owner
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证拥有者的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: fuzzy_owner_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: Fuzzy match of the JoinEUI of the join permission
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_eui

parameters.help_en: Filters join permissions by enabled or disabled status
parameters.help_zh: 按照凭证的启停用状态进行过滤
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en:
Filters join permissions by whether they are associated with a node group.

A value of true indicates associated. A value of false indicates not associated
parameters.help_zh:
根据入网凭证是否关联到节点分组进行过滤。

true表示已关联，false表示未关联
parameters.name: bound_node_group

parameters.help_en:
Filters join permissions by type. Valid values:

LOCAL: dedicated join permission
ROAMING: roaming join permission
parameters.help_zh:
按照凭证的类型进行过滤。取值：

LOCAL：专用凭证
ROAMING：泛在凭证
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: Fuzzy match of the name of the join permission
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证的名称
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_permission_name

Data.description_en: The total number of join permissions that match the filter conditions
Data.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的入网凭证总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
